shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' lib/db.js && sed -n '1,200p' package.json && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,200p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,160p' app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && rg -n \"function revalidateTag|revalidateTag\\(\" node_modules/next/dist/server node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.ts' | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -n \"cacheComponents\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/next/cache.d.ts && rg -n \"export.*cacheTag|declare function cacheTag|use cache.*cacheComponents\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,180p' && rg -n '\"use cache\"|\\x27use cache\\x27' node_modules/next/dist/build -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1190,1245p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js && sed -n '1470,1510p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && rg -n \"cacheComponents.*use cache|useCache.*cacheComponents|cacheComponents.*enabled\" node_modules/next/dist/build node_modules/next/dist/server -g '*.js' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short 2>/dev/null || true && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,80p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,140p' && nl -ba next.config.ts | sed -n '1,60p' && git status --short"
